items.title: Energy efficiency Tier 1 of section 9.36.
items.scope: To provide information regarding the changes to the adopted energy efficiency Tier 1 of Section 9.36. of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)).

items.title: Roof truss layout for one- and two-family dwellings
items.scope: To provide information regarding the status for the acceptance of roof truss layout drawings for one- and two- family dwellings that typically would not require professional involvement unless the scope of the construction or component is not addressed by Part 9 of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)).

items.title: Roof trusses for one- and two-family dwellings
items.scope: To provide information regarding the status for the acceptance of roof truss drawings for one- and two-family dwellings that typically would not require professional involvement unless the scope of the construction or component is not addressed by Part 9 of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)).

items.title: SEER2 and HSPF2 application
items.scope: This bulletin provides information on the latest energy efficiency metrics for air-cooled unitary air conditioners and heat pumps that are electrically operated.

items.title: Houses with a secondary suite
items.scope: This bulletin is developed to consolidate secondary suite provisions within one document.

items.title: Houses with a secondary suite

items.title: Occupancy of buildings under construction
items.scope: To provide guidance for determining when occupancy of a building under construction may be allowed.

items.title: Sprinkler systems with antifreeze solutions
items.scope: To provide clarification of the acceptance of sprinkler systems which require the use of an antifreeze solution.

items.title: Radon/soil gas pipe labelling
items.scope: This bulletin identifies the requirements within the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) for labeling of radon/soil gas pipes.

items.title: Access to roof-mounted HVAC equipment
items.scope: To provide guidance for access to roof-mounted HVAC equipment systems installed in compliance with the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) and the references from CSA B149.1:25 Natural gas and propane installation code (CSA B149.1:25). The NBC(AE) 1st printing currently references the B149.1:20 edition.

items.title: 2021 Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, Section 64
items.scope: Industry has identified concerns regarding Energy Storage System (ESS) requirements. This variance permits the installation of an ESS at a dwelling unit or residential occupancy not exceeding 20 kWh for any single ESS, as an alternative method to the C22.1:21 - Canadian Electrical Code, Part I.

items.title: Errata
items.scope: The National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition came into force on May 1, 2024. It was discovered that the published document contains some technical errors. This errata corrects those errors.

items.title: Approved organization - QAI Laboratories
items.scope: To recognize an organization which issues evaluation reports used to determine compliance with the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) as being an approved organization in Alberta.

items.title: Approved organization - Underwriters Laboratories of Canada Inc./UL Solutions
items.scope: To recognize an organization which issues evaluation reports used to determine compliance with the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) as being an approved organization in Alberta.

items.title: Approved organization - Intertek
items.scope: To recognize an organization which issues evaluation reports used to determine compliance with the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) as being an approved organization in Alberta.

items.title: Smoke detectors in smoke or fire/smoke damper installation
items.scope: Clarifies whether the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) requires a smoke detector as part of a smoke or fire/smoke damper operation to be connected to the fire alarm system (FAS).

items.title: Existing fire alarm systems
items.scope: To clarify requirements where an existing fire alarm system (FAS), regardless of age, requires inspection, testing, maintenance, and installation of devices or other equipment (e.g., maglocks) to provide or maintain an expected level of safety for occupants. In addition, this interpretation defines who can install, verify, inspect, test, and maintain an FAS.

items.title: NFPA 33 spray booths, application of the safety codes
items.scope: This clarifies the requirements for permitting under the Safety Codes Act (SCA) and Permit Regulation for the installation of spray booths, spray areas, and spray rooms.

items.title: Approved organization - ICC Evaluation Service
items.scope: To recognize an organization which issues evaluation reports used in determining compliance with the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) as being an approved organization in Alberta.

items.title: Integrated testing coordinator
items.scope: To clarify the expectation for qualifications of an “integrated testing coordinator.”

items.title: Wood roof truss systems in Part 9 buildings
items.scope: To provide clarity of the requirement for professional involvement in wood roof truss system designs used in Part 9 buildings.

items.title: Design of wood trusses for roof assemblies in Part 9 buildings
items.scope: To clarify the requirement for professional involvement in the design of wood trusses for roof assemblies used in Part 9 buildings.

items.title: Barrier-free design requirements: relaxations
items.scope: To clarify when a request for relaxation of barrier-free requirements is appropriate, and provide exempted building uses where a relaxation request is not required.

items.title: Barrier-free design requirements: relaxations
items.scope: To clarify when a request for relaxation of barrier-free requirements is appropriate.

items.title: Photoluminescent exit signs
items.scope: This interpretation provides clarification regarding the required illumination of photoluminescent (PL) exit signs according to Articles 3.4.5.1. and 9.9.11.3. of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)).

items.title: Guard requirements for glazing in a window
items.scope: To clarify the application of guard requirements when glazing in a window is positioned below the minimum height requirements within the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)).

items.title: Occupancy classification for supportive living accommodations
items.scope: To clarify the application of the Safety Codes Act (Act) and the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) in determining the occupancy classification of buildings intended for clients receiving various levels of supportive living accommodation.

items.title: Relocatable industrial accommodation labeling
items.scope: To recognize new Part 10 units certified and labelled in accordance with CSA-A277 “Procedure for certification of prefabricated buildings, modules, and panels,” and clarify renovation and labelling procedures for existing Part 10 units.

items.title: Energy efficiency exemptions for buildings
items.scope: To assist in identifying certain types and uses of buildings, such as buildings constructed to shelter equipment which has been established to be exempt from Section 9.36., “Energy Efficiency,” of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) and the National Energy Code of Canada for Buildings 2020 (NECB).

items.title: “Building Envelope” definition related to attic or roof spaces
items.scope: This interpretation clarifies the intended meaning of “building envelope” in the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) as it relates to the expected performance of attic or roof spaces.

items.title: Elevator operation and accessibility for residential buildings
items.scope: This is to clarify the application of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) for elevators to be operational in residential buildings required to have a barrier-free path of travel.

items.title: Attached garage separation serving a house with a secondary suite
items.scope: To clarify the application of Sentence 9.10.9.18.(3) of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) to a house with a secondary suite.

items.title: Approved organization- APA - The Engineered Wood Association
items.scope: To recognize an organization which issues evaluation reports used in determining compliance with the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) as being an approved organization in Alberta.

items.title: Lightning protection systems
items.scope: To clarify the requirements for installing, altering, or adding to lightning protection systems. This clarification is for building owners, operators, designers, and electricians, as well as safety codes officers (SCOs) in the building and electrical disciplines.

items.title: Overnight child care
items.scope: To clarify applicable requirements of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) and the National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE)) for occupancies licensed to provide overnight child care services.

items.title: Occupant loads
items.scope: To provide a consistent method for calculating occupant loads for assembly occupancies under the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) and National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE)).

items.scope: To clarify the requirements for measures to mitigate fire spread to adjacent buildings, water supply, and access for firefighting as per the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) and the National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE)).

items.scope: To clarify the application of the National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)) and the National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE)) to buildings used for parking, repairing, and/or servicing of tank vehicles.

items.title: Hydronic heating systems
